data.content: For site-year-quarter events where the sumTU for both algae and fish exceeds 0.0001, what is the average ratio of the fish sumTU to the algae sumTU, and what are the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of this ratio?

args.query: For all site-year-quarter events, filter to those where sumTU for algae exceeds 0.0001 and sumTU for fish exceeds 0.0001. For each remaining event, compute the ratio = fish_sumTU / algae_sumTU. Return: (1) the number of events included, (2) the average of the ratio across events, (3) the 2.5th percentile of the ratio distribution, and (4) the 97.5th percentile of the ratio distribution.

            MATCH (site:Site)-[ra:SUMMARIZED_IMPACT_ON]->(:Species {name: 'algae'}),

WHERE ra.year = rf.year
  AND ra.quarter = rf.quarter
  AND ra.sumTU > 0.0001
  AND rf.sumTU > 0.0001
WITH site.name AS SiteName, ra.year AS Year, ra.quarter AS Quarter, (rf.sumTU / ra.sumTU) AS ratio
